Class GameScreen

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.Screen<TUIScreen>
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.TUIScreen
org.adsl.client.view.tui.screens.GameScreen
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventVisitor<TUIScreen>, InputEventVisitor
public class GameScreen extends TUIScreen
Main game screen, implemented as a non-blocking state machine that drives the stateless board/panel renderers in org.adsl.client.view.tui.game.

Server events (GameUpdateEvent, EndGameEvent) and input events (ConfirmEvent, SelectEvent, navigate events) are all dispatched through the visitor pattern. This class keeps only controller state (turn sub-state, selection, scroll offsets and overlay flags); each render pass it builds an immutable TuiBoardRenderer.BoardFrame snapshot and hands it, plus the player panels and overlays, to the dedicated renderers — mirroring the GUI's GameScreen / BoardRenderer / PlayerPanelsRenderer split.
